purpose: Test-wiring meta-gate. Every `node --test` invocation in this repo is an explicit filename list, because four checkers assert on those literal "node --test scripts/<name>.test.mjs" substrings (scripts/check-operation-coverage.mjs, scripts/lib/consumer-cast-contract.mjs, scripts/check-release-dispatch-guard.mjs, scripts/check-mcp-release-workflow.test.mjs) and a glob would erase them. The cost of explicit lists is that adding a test and forgetting to wire it is silent -- which is exactly what happened: 24 of 51 test files under scripts/ were executed by nothing, including five that contracts cited as proof. So discovery lives here, in a gate that AUDITS the list, rather than in the runner that would replace it. Wired into `make aggregate-gates`, which already owns Makefile-wiring semantics.

unwiredTests.reason: New H3 harness (SDK client + CLI --json + MCP InMemoryTransport driven against one shared mock-clockify-server.mjs instance, normalized to a common outcome shape). No existing wired test file shares this subject (checked: generate-product-surface.test.mjs and generate-operation-parity.test.mjs are the only Makefile-wired tests with an adjacent name, and neither drives cross-surface runtime behavior). Also needs `node --import tsx --test` rather than plain `node --test` (it imports .ts source directly), so wiring it changes the invocation shape, not just the filename list. The Makefile line that would name it directly is a governed live-evidence input.
unwiredTests.disposition: Add its own `node --import tsx --test scripts/behavior-parity/behavior-parity.test.mjs` line to the Makefile once P5 (campaign Phase D step 7) wires H3 into release-proof sampling, then delete this entry. (H4's own debt fold-in landed separately, with P1, once its own consumer condition was met -- see the published-surface-diff Makefile target.)

unwiredTests.reason: New H1 harness (pack all three packages, install together into one scratch npm project, print its path). No existing wired test file shares this subject -- deliberately does NOT reuse scripts/pack-consumer-smoke.mjs's pack()/tempProject()/install() (that script's requiredScriptMarkers contract check greps its OWN running source text for fixed markers; extracting those functions would silently move markers out and red that gate), so scripts/pack-consumer-smoke.test.mjs is not the right home either. The Makefile line that would name it directly is a governed live-evidence input.
unwiredTests.disposition: Add its own `node --test scripts/create-naive-subject-install.test.mjs` line to the Makefile once D4/D5 (campaign Phase E, post-batch) consume H1, in the same governed Makefile batch as the other four entries, then delete this entry.
